paragraphs: With MLVisionRN, developers can harness the power of React Native to create high performance Vision applications that run flawlessly across multiple platforms. This Universal application leverages React Native's versatility to provide a consistent user experience on both Vision Pro and iPhone devices. Experience silky smooth performance at 60 frames per second, ensuring a seamless and responsive user interface on every device. Inspired by Apple's Hello World example for Vision OS, MLVisionRN brings cross-platform Vision development to the forefront. While the code is provided as is and not officially supported by Apple or Facebook, it offers a solid foundation for developers to build upon.
